findings.claim: The plan omits required Kimi Code plugin/marketplace packaging despite G5 explicitly requiring Kimi Code.
findings.evidence: Goal G5 requires "packaged as plugins and marketplaces for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Kimi Code", but the plan cuts it: "Kimi plugin packaging is cut this phase" and mcp-plugin-marketplaces covers only "Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode."
findings.suggested_fix: Add a Kimi Code plugin/marketplace change or explicitly revise the goal/scope with an approved waiver before planning execution.

findings.claim: The execution order schedules work before its stated dependency on operator approval is satisfied.
findings.evidence: mcp-adrs-and-team-ownership task 1.5 has prerequisite "PR-1" and change details include updating team ownership and granting root go.mod/go.sum paths; Round 1 runs "mcp-tool-contract", "mcp-adrs-and-team-ownership", and "webmcp-host-spike" in parallel, while mcp-tool-contract task 1.5 changes root dependencies via "google/jsonschema-go via go get + make mod_tidy" before the ownership grant in 1.5 can complete.
findings.suggested_fix: Make the approval/ownership grant an initial serial prerequisite before any change that touches newly governed paths or root go.mod/go.sum.

findings.claim: The plan conflicts with the project constraint that AGENTS.md changes ship separately.
findings.evidence: The constraint says "AGENTS.md changes ship in their own PR, never alongside code", while the plan says "No separate AGENTS.md commit task" and "Operator approval and commit including AGENTS.md."
findings.suggested_fix: Either remove AGENTS.md from the final mixed commit or record a formal constraint waiver outside the plan mechanism that the phase boundary can enforce.

findings.claim: Acceptance for the cross-family review gate is ambiguous because the plan allows proceeding when the required judge prerequisite is unresolved.
findings.evidence: G7 requires "independent security and quality review at the phase boundary" and phase-boundary-review task 1.4 depends on "PR-3"; the risks section states "If PR-3 stays unresolved, the phase boundary has same-family review only, and the reflection must say so," which contradicts treating the cross-family judge as part of the phase boundary gate.
findings.suggested_fix: Make PR-3 blocking for phase completion or define an explicit approved fallback review route with acceptance criteria before execution.
